newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended firmer in moderate volume after weak U.S. employment numbers and declining Swiss franc swap rates bolstered sentiment already made bullish by the U.S. Fed's decision to leave rates steady, dealers said.
The Swiss National Bank left its discount rate unchanged.

One dealer said the market was also helped by easier conditions on the money market after tension seen in the run-up to the semester's end. SNB economist Georg Rich said firmer money rates of late resulted from normal fluctuations in demand.
Euro Swiss francs up seven at 98.46.
